title: CSIT Congress 2026 in Aalborg
content:
CSIT Congress 2026 in Aalborg

### 

* [![](http://kowsc.or.kr/data/file/news/thumb-547a3cd47dfb738b599bfd6e3516caff_rFHoAwNI_32cf96902e86c77e072516abd2d5af7c3f9c46d4_600x782.jpg)](http://kowsc.or.kr/bbs/view_image.php?bo_table=news&fn=547a3cd47dfb738b599bfd6e3516caff_rFHoAwNI_32cf96902e86c77e072516abd2d5af7c3f9c46d4.jpg)

To all CSIT Member Unions,
Dear Presidents and General Secretaries,
To all the members of the CSIT Executive Committee,
To Chairmen and Secretaries of Technical Commissions,
To Partners of CSIT,

 
The city of Aalborg is delighted to invite you to the **48th CONGRESS** of the **CSIT** **\- International Workers and Amateurs in Sports Confederation**, an ordinary Congress, held **from October 12th to 18th, 2026 in Aalborg / Denmark**, the host city of the [IX. CSIT World Sports Games 2027](https://www.csit.sport/events/wsg/2027).

 
The official invitation of the congress as well as the registration form can be found in the attachment.

 
Thank you very much and in case of further questions, please do not hesitate to contact our colleagues from Aalborg or the CSIT Office anytime.

 

 

 
Yours sincerely,
Meilleures salutations,

 

 
**Wolfgang Burghardt**

 
Secretary General
Secrétaire Général
